_header: PAIRED FILE. Byte-identical copies: BE src/model/catalog/__tests__/name-key.vectors.json and SC stone_pipeline/tests/fixtures/name_key_vectors.json. A change to either normaliser is a PAIRED PR in both repos, each green on the same vectors. Generated by SC stone_pipeline/tests/gen_name_key_vectors.py from the scraper's match_key (SC stone_pipeline/core/text.py). PREPARATION, shared by the key and both display rules (the key skips it for ASCII text, where it never changes the key): (a) typographic forms unified (curly quotes, the backtick, the acute accent and the modifier apostrophe to ', curly double quotes to \", the minus sign to -, the zero-width space to a space, the micro sign to u); (b) on the ORIGINAL characters, a non-ASCII dash (Pd) to -, a non-ASCII punctuation or symbol (P*, S*) whose NFKD, mapped through (a), is one ASCII punctuation character (a fullwidth, small, vertical, superscript or subscript form) to that character, any other non-ASCII punctuation, symbol, private-use (Co), unassigned (Cn) or surrogate (Cs) character to a space; (c) NFKD-decompose and drop every mark (M*); (d) step (b) again on what decomposition yields; (e) every whitespace or control (Cc) character to a space, every format (Cf) character removed. KEY (`expected`, match_key): (0) every '&' becomes ' and ' (owner D1, 2026-11-04); (1) every [^\w\s] (Python unicode \w, \s) and '_' becomes a space; (2) ascii_fold: unless plain ASCII, NFKD-decompose, drop every mark, transliterate the letters with no decomposition (_TRANSLIT), drop remaining non-ASCII; (3) casefold, which after step 2 is ASCII lower-case; (4) split on whitespace, join with one space. DISPLAY, two kinds (owner 2026-11-03): REFUSED (null) if a letter other than a modifier letter (Lm) has no ASCII form; otherwise ascii_fold. NAME (`display`, clean_name): '&' to ' and '; every character outside [A-Za-z0-9 '-] to a space; apostrophe runs to one; an apostrophe not between two letters or digits to a space; hyphen runs and spaces around a hyphen collapse to one hyphen; whitespace collapsed; leading and trailing hyphens and spaces stripped. IDENTIFIER (`identifier`, clean_identifier): printable ASCII kept, whitespace collapsed and trimmed. Case is kept. ALIAS (`alias`, clean_alias; 34's OWNED-NAMES-CLEAN row, 13 Nov; Mas: mojibake is the ONLY refusal, no length bound): REFUSED (null) first if the RAW value holds '?' or U+FFFD with a letter (any script, L*) on both sides (mojibake: 'K?r?ehir'; 'Who? Me' and 'Picass?' are not). Otherwise, in order: (1) every format (Cf) character removed (a zero-width space goes, never a space); (2) the alias typographic table (the backtick, the acute accent, the curly single quotes and the modifier apostrophe to ', curly double quotes to \", the minus sign to -) and every dash (Pd) to -; (3) NFC (accents kept, never folded; no script dropped); (4) '&' to ' and '; (5) every character that is not a letter (L*), a combining mark in U+0300-U+036F, an ASCII digit, a space, an apostrophe or a hyphen to a space; (6) apostrophe runs to one; an apostrophe is kept only when a letter (L*), a combining mark in U+0300-U+036F or an ASCII digit is before it AND a letter (L*) or an ASCII digit is after it, else it becomes a space; hyphen runs and spaces around a hyphen collapse to one hyphen; whitespace collapsed; leading and trailing hyphens and spaces stripped; nothing left is REFUSED (null). Case is kept. The database class it equals: ^[[:alpha:]\u0300-\u036f0-9 '-]+$. ALIAS KEY (`alias_key`, alias_key; Mas, 13 Nov): the key of an alias value. If the RAW value has no letter (L*) outside the Latin script (Scripts.txt sc=Latn, JS \p{Script=Latin}; a letter of script Common is outside), it is the matching key (`expected`). Otherwise: every format (Cf) character removed; NFKC; the default lowercase mapping (Python str.lower, JS toLowerCase; NOT casefold, so a final sigma stays); every character that is not a letter (L*), a mark (M*) or a decimal digit (Nd, any script) to a space; whitespace collapsed and trimmed. An empty key is refused by the callers. UNICODE: every input uses only code points assigned in Unicode 14.0.0, the floor across the runtimes in use (SC deploy and CI: Python 3.12 = Unicode 15.0.0; SC CI syntax floor: Python 3.11 = 14.0.0). Both repos must agree on every case; each repo's test asserts its runtime Unicode version is at least 14.0.0.
